title: Photosynthesis - Calvin Cycle
body:
The diagram below shows the Calvin Cycle (light-independent reactions):

```
[CALVIN CYCLE DIAGRAM]
                    CO2 (from air)
                       |
                       v
    RuBP (5C) ----> 3-PGA (3C) x 2
       ^               |
       |          [ATP, NADPH used]
       |               v
    [ATP used]     G3P (3C) x 2
       |               |
       +----<----+-----+
                 |      
              (1 G3P exits to make glucose)
```

If 6 molecules of CO2 enter the Calvin Cycle, how many molecules of G3P are produced, and how many are used to regenerate RuBP?
